description: Work by Riya Dutta: LinkedIn campaigns, a website, the content system behind them, research on how people decide, a live data site and a copy tool.
intro: Campaigns, a website, research, and the system that makes the campaigns.

items.title: The Haunted CRM
items.blurb: Fifteen CRM problems told as ghost stories across five days.

items.title: The Founder Bottleneck
items.blurb: One week, three chapters, on what stops when everything runs through the founder.

items.title: The Content Studio
items.blurb: The production system behind every campaign, from brief to posted piece.

items.title: The B2Ne website
items.blurb: How to look credible with nothing to show. Co-built with the founder.

items.title: CRM Graveyard
items.blurb: Fourteen posts and two videos, a different visual idea for every post.

items.title: TRACE-BRL
items.blurb: A maturity model for behavioural research labs, under review.

items.title: The Gifting Index
items.blurb: Which perfume houses get bought as gifts? Six houses as stems in one vase, a gift finder and a card to keep. Updated daily.

items.title: Fire Flowers
items.blurb: Fireworks over a river by night, real flowers by day. A small game in the browser.

items.title: Market Day
items.blurb: Mind a stall at a hill market. Set the prices, pick the sign, see who buys and why. Three days, from sunshine to snow, and different every visit.

lab_intro: Things I make on my own time. Each one has a site of its own.
